I've answered Dana in her #north-team thread. The only seat count Dana can see for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is the 261 Ilse posted in #north-team on Oct 14, and I couldn't check it against anything.

- **No signed copy or account record:** none of the files or channels Dana can open has the renewal contract or a record with the seat count.
- **Older count:** the last confirmed figure in #north-team is 185 seats, from Amendment No. 1 in August 2025.
- **Renewal digest:** a Moss digest says the renewal was signed on 2026-03-20 but gives no seat count.

I told Dana that 261 is Ilse's figure and that Ilse or June (deal desk) can confirm it before it goes in the tracker.
